statement: A categorical distribution is a discrete probability distribution that describes the possible results of a random variable that can take on one of K possible categories, parameterized by a probability vector p = (p_1, ..., p_K) where 0 <= p_i <= 1 and sum_{i=1}^K p_i = 1, with p_i = P(X = i). Its probability mass function can be expressed using the Iverson bracket as f(x | p) = prod_{i=1}^K p_i^[x=i], or equivalently for a 1-of-K encoded random vector x as f(x | p) = prod_{i=1}^K p_i^(x_i).

symbols.meaning: number of possible categories or outcomes
outcome represented as a category label in {1, ..., K} or a 1-of-K encoded vector
Iverson bracket evaluating to 1 if x = i and 0 otherwise

properties.why: The parameters p lie on the standard (K - 1)-dimensional simplex defined by sum_{i=1}^K p_i = 1 and 0 <= p_i <= 1
E[x] = p for a 1-of-K encoded random vector x
The indicator function [x = i] (or Kronecker delta delta_{xi}) of category i is Bernoulli distributed with parameter p_i
The categorical distribution is a special case of the multinomial distribution with n = 1; the sum of n i.i.d. categorical random vectors is multinomially distributed with parameters n and p
The set of counts (or proportions) of observations in each category from n independent trials is the sufficient statistic
The Dirichlet distribution Dir(K, alpha) is the conjugate prior for the parameter vector p, yielding posterior Dir(K, c + alpha) given observation counts c

assumptions.assumption: Probabilities must be non-negative and sum to 1: sum_{i=1}^K p_i = 1 and p_i >= 0 for all i
assumptions.breaks_when: Any p_i < 0, p_i > 1, or sum_{i=1}^K p_i != 1

assumptions.assumption: Categories are mutually exclusive and exhaustive (exactly one outcome chosen per draw)
assumptions.breaks_when: Multiple categories occur simultaneously or no category occurs, violating sum_{i=1}^K x_i = 1 in the 1-of-K formulation

failure_modes.signature: Total probability across the sample space does not equal 1
failure_modes.cause: Parameter components p_i do not sum to 1 or fall outside [0, 1]

failure_modes.mode: Invalid MAP estimate under Dirichlet prior
failure_modes.signature: Mode of the posterior distribution is undefined or falls outside the open simplex
failure_modes.cause: Condition alpha_i + c_i > 1 fails for one or more categories i
